nodes.name: 登阶
nodes.light: pale cold gold of first daylight from the left, long soft shadows across the ploughed field, deep blue-grey shade under the war construct
nodes.camera: low, from the foot of the plinth at the squad leader's shoulder, looking up past him at the colossal heel door and the armour above; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn on the first morning of a great enterprise, at the southmost segment-fortress of a long white-stone wall, harvest fields on the near side and a bare pale haze beyond the wall. A huge plinth of stacked stone, taller than the fortress wall itself, rises in the middle of a half-ploughed wheat field on the right half of the picture, and on it stands the first sky-tall war construct, so enormous that the frame cuts it off at the chest: layered plates of dark silver armour engraved with fine elven runes, dragonkin scales set like bright bronze studs on its shoulders, its feet planted wide on the plinth, and in its heel a dark doorway as tall as a house. Rows of footprint pits, filled with rainwater, trail back across the field behind it, and a few sheep are drinking at the nearest one. On the left, small in the middle ground, a long single-file line of spell-corps soldiers in grey-blue coats climbs the plinth's wide stone steps toward the heel door, helmets under their arms. In the near left foreground, large, stands the squad leader at the heel door, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see his cheek and an old scar across it: a stooped, broad-shouldered man of seventy-two with short white hair and a trimmed white beard, legs planted wide as if on a rolling deck, in a navy oilcloth coat, an open ledger in his left hand and a pencil in his right. In front of him, facing him and facing us, a young woman of eighteen has stopped on the bottom step: sturdy, coppery hair cut just below the ears, verdigris-blue eyes, a bronze pendant on a cord at her throat, her grey-blue corps coat buttoned to the chin. She is speaking her name aloud, bright and a little restless, and he is just about to tick it in the ledger. Far behind on the wall, a few small figures look down. Ploughed earth, drifting chaff and wheat straw whirl large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取一幕第 664 行，沃普克在脚跟门口念名字点名，梅特是第一批上去的人。梅特 18 岁入画无伤。台基和脚坑取第 658 行。

nodes.name: 空当
nodes.light: blinding white from the clash ahead, with the amber-red of a furnace on the right, and the cold blue-grey of dead sand below
nodes.camera: low and wide from the sand just behind the colossus's heel, looking up at its back and the two white flashes beyond its shoulder; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the middle of a vast plain of glassy sand in the dead zone, bleached to white, in the middle of a day-long fight between two gods. Far ahead on the horizon two immense glares of white light, one to the left and one to the right, are about to meet in the same instant. In the centre of the picture the sky-tall war construct stands with its back to us and its armoured arms half lifted, so huge that the frame cuts it off at the waist; its runic plates glow gold-white from the feet to the head, every engraved line lit at once. Right in front of its chest the two waves of light have just collided and burst apart: a wall of white sand rises on both sides and sweeps away to left and right like two curtains, leaving a dark open road of undisturbed sand running straight back behind the machine toward us. Between its feet small iron wolves, bone and black iron, are being crushed into the sand. Along the bottom of the picture, a cutaway of the furnace belly at the left foot: a short, stocky dwarf woman of a hundred and ninety, snow-white hair in one thick braid wound once around her neck, orange-red eyes, palms flat on a furnace grate, soot on her leather apron, her lips moving in a steady count of names, while inside the grate a straight column of gold flame stands upright. A small brass lamp hangs at her belt. Fine glass shards, white sand and sparks whirl large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取二幕第 675 行两样余波撞在一处的那一下，兰薇格在腹舱按栅是第 677 行，这里并在一幅里作近景。擎天级只画背面，不画那一位和那一尊（锁）。

nodes.name: 自行
nodes.light: faint cold blue-gold glow leaking from the runic seams of the armour, against a deep black-blue night and one low band of white at the horizon
nodes.camera: from the sand ahead and to the left of the colossus, low, looking up at it as it steps toward us; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on the long road back north across the dead-zone sand, under a sky with no heavenly body in it, only a low band of pale light along the southern horizon. The sky-tall war construct is walking toward us, enormous, seen from the front at three-quarter and cut off at the chest by the top of the frame. Its left leg drags behind it: the knee joint is fused and glowing dull red where sand has melted around it, the lower leg a scorched rough patch, and a long furrow runs back across the sand behind that leg. Runic lines on its armour glow only faintly, cold blue-gold. Across its chest in the lit seams of a ventilation slot, small, we see the inside of the vast round chamber like a glowing honeycomb: three rings of tiny seated figures, every head bowed, mouths shut, nobody chanting. In the lower right foreground, inset as a close view into the lit slot, one young woman of eighteen sits in an outer-ring seat: coppery hair cut just below the ears, verdigris-blue eyes, a bronze pendant on her chest, a knife in her hand and a small bell-shaped beating-clock held on her knee, her head leaning back against the seat, her lips parted and nothing coming out of them. Behind her, ropes tie shapeless shrouded figures into the seats beside her. Beyond the construct, far behind it in the north, a row of faint tiny watch-fires waits on the top of the wall. Fine white sand and ash hang large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取三幕上旬七日夜里（第 685 行）所有人都念不动，它照换班的铃自己走了一夜。梅特是敲拍的人。

nodes.name: 座背
nodes.light: warm orange furnace light from the right, cool blue-green flame flickering in the carved lines of the seat backs on the left
nodes.camera: low among the seats, looking along a curved row of tall seat backs, the copper-haired woman near foreground; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep winter inside the great round chamber of a sky-tall war construct, being repaired, in the workshop's furnace light. We stand among the rings of seats, looking along the curve of a row of high seat backs. Every seat back is carved with names in deep letters, row after row of them, and from the carvings thin blue-green flame licks up slowly and sinks back. In the near left foreground, large, a young woman of eighteen kneels on the seat step with her back to a seat, seen at three-quarter, one cheek and one verdigris-blue eye visible: sturdy, coppery hair cut below the ears like a freshly cast bell, a thin scar across her right index finger, a small bronze pendant on her throat, a quick chisel in her right hand and a small wooden mallet in her left; she has just cut one name and is blowing dust from the groove, her face tired and set. A bell-shaped beating-clock hangs at her belt. Behind her, a few steps down the aisle on the right, a short stocky dwarf woman of a hundred and ninety stands with her palms resting on a brazier, snow-white braid wound once around her neck, orange-red eyes watching the flame, a small brass lamp at her belt. Far behind them, rows of empty seats curve away into the dark. Chisel dust, chips of stone and drifting sparks hang large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取收束第 692 行梅特冬天在座背上刻名字、青焰蹿进舱里，兰薇格在远处守炉（第 694 行）。

nodes.name: 坞口
nodes.light: low gold light of an autumn sunrise from the right, lighting the steam, against deep blue shade inside the dock
nodes.camera: from the wall-walk above the dock gate, looking down and slightly sideways at the ship's bow as it pushes out; tilted
nodes.text: Scene: autumn sunrise at a dockyard on the southmost edge of a great wall, on a day the whole fortress has come out to see. A huge land-ship, as long as a city street, is crawling out of its dock into the open gate: two wide caterpillar tracks each broader than a train carriage grind over the flagstones, three folded barrier-panels lie along its back, and at the middle stands a tall brass mast crowned with a ring of bells. Steam from a row of capstans along the dock edge billows up gold in the sunrise. On the left side of the picture the bow looms large and is cut off by the frame; on the bow's rail, in the near foreground, stands the ship's captain, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one cheek: a fifty-eight-year-old woman, tall, broad in the shoulder and straight-backed, her knees soft as if on a pitching deck, short greying hair cut at the ears with a brass clip, windburned cheeks, a thumb-sized bronze bell at her right ear, in an oilskin navy coat. She is looking not forward but back at the wall. Behind the ship, following in neat rows, comes a column of two hundred tall man-shaped clockwork soldiers with brass keys on their backs, and in the distance, small, a pale haze of the dead zone waits beyond the gate. On the wall top, packed along the parapet, are small figures of soldiers and craftsmen with raised hands; in the stubble field below the wall, children gleaning ears of wheat have stopped to watch. Drifting steam, straw and falling leaves cross the near corners large and out of focus.
nodes.note: 取一幕第 925 行长链号爬出坞门，舰长在舰首，墙上的兵说船下水了。第 915 行写了地里捡麦穗的孩子。

nodes.name: 朝北
nodes.light: cold white-grey light over the dead plain, with a warm yellow from the ship's lamp falling on the man at the window
nodes.camera: from outside and slightly above the ship's flank at a lit cabin porthole, looking over the man's shoulder at the field beyond; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in the dead zone, on a plain of white ash. Six hundred and forty tall man-shaped clockwork soldiers kneel in rows across the whole plain, every one facing north, their heads bowed, their brass keys stopped upright on their backs, a thin layer of white ash on their shoulders, their steam whistles rusted shut. In the front row the legs of some have been gnawed through by iron beasts and lie in broken pieces; a lead machine with a bell-crown folded down kneels at the very front. We look from a lit porthole of the huge land-ship: its dark hull plates fill the left edge of the picture, its tracks creep slowly along beside the kneeling rows, and the warm lamp of the cabin spills over the sill. In the near foreground at the porthole stands the winder, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see only part of his profile and one pale violet eye: a very tall, thin man of about fifty-five, back slightly bent, silver-white hair tied at the back, two short horns lying back along his skull, the left one chipped, and a thin tail with a small brass whistle at its tip hanging behind him. He leans his forehead near the glass and has a small ledger in his hand; his lips are moving, saying every name. Beyond the field, far away on the horizon, a pale band shows the edge of the white-lit sky. Pale ash flakes drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取二幕中旬六日第 931 行，那一片跪着的六百四十台，达里奥贴着舷窗挨个念名字。

nodes.name: 推杆
nodes.light: hot orange from lamps and a few cold-fire shots in the dark, with a pale blue band of dawn beginning at the horizon
nodes.camera: low and close from among the pushing crew beside the capstan, looking up at the girl on top of it; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the middle of the night in the dead zone, the land-ship halted and its runic lines on the hull dark, an iron beast the size of a tower clamped by its jaw to the left track in the background. In the centre, high on top of the ship's stern capstan, a small fox-eared girl of twenty-one stands with one arm flung out, her mouth open, shouting; her upright ears with white tufts are laid back, her short apricot-yellow hair stands out in every direction, her tail is swung up before her and tied at the tip with a bright brass bell that she is shaking with all her force. Around the capstan, crowded in a ring in the near foreground and partly cut off by the frame, forty or so sailors and crew in oilskin coats lean on twelve long push-bars, two at each bar, their backs bent, their boots digging into the ash, singing a heave-song together; behind them a sloping line of ropes. Under the hanging lamps their shadows lie standing upright behind them on the deck, each tall and clear. At the top of the picture the brass mast stands, and on it a tall thin man with silver hair clings with one arm while shaking a ring of bells with the other. In the dark beyond the circle of lamps, a line of kneeling-then-risen clockwork soldiers hold their shields up in a ring around the ship while sparks and cold crystal fire fly across it. Ash and sparks whirl large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取三幕半夜船停了、嘉妮跳上绞盘摇铃、大家推（第 942 行），灯底下影子又站起来。桅顶的达里奥只写远处小人。

nodes.name: 垛口
nodes.light: warm orange from a few torches on the parapet, pale cold white from the dead zone far in the south, a deep blue winter night
nodes.camera: along the wall-top at a soldier's height, behind a row of backs, looking out over the parapet toward the dark south; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a deep winter night on the wall-top of the southmost segment of a great white-stone wall, snow lying in the gaps of the crenels. In the near foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, stands a soldier seen from behind at three-quarter, a broad man of about forty in a wool cloak with the hood back, leaning both forearms on the stone, his head tilted as if listening. Beside him on the left stand two other soldiers in the same pose, one young and one grizzled, all of them looking south. Out beyond the wall, far away on the plain, a column of tall clockwork soldiers with brass keys on their backs marches into the dark in rows, small, their steam whistles letting out long thin notes, each pitched differently, and one of them has a bell-crown lifted at the head of the column; a few faint warm lights show on their chests. At the foot of the wall, in the small yard below, a squat land-ship sits in its dock with steam rising from the capstans. The soldier on the right has his hand cupped behind his ear and a half-smile; his lips are parted as if about to say that one is mine. The far southern sky is a low pale band. Falling snow and sparks from the torches drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取收束第 954 行，那一冬夜里墙上起过名字的兵站在垛口上听得出自己起的那一台的汽笛。无立绘人物。

nodes.name: 井边
nodes.light: cold blue-white starless night, a thin pale light along the ground, three dying warm yellow lights in the distance
nodes.camera: low at the well's rim behind the woman's shoulder, looking across a flat wasteland toward the camps; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the dead of night on a flat grey wasteland, a lone stone well at the left with a bucket rope, the sky black and empty. Far across the plain, three great round pits sink into the ground, their stepped walls ringed with streets, each with a tall whitewashed bell tower at the middle, and on each tower the last lamp is going out. Between the pits and us, striding across the plain from the right, a titanic humanoid figure bends down at the rim of one pit, so tall that its head is out of the frame at the top: a dark shape whose every joint of bone and limb is folded the wrong way, elbows and knees reversed, long fingers hanging. It is bending, as though picking something up from the pit. Close in the left foreground, at the well, a thirty-one-year-old woman stands seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one cheek: sturdy, ash-grey skin all over her face and hands, frost-white hair cut at the chin blowing back, a white strip of bone set into the skin along her left forearm, a half-filled water skin held in one hand, three bony pack beasts waiting patiently behind her with their halters in her other hand. She is standing perfectly still, her pale amber eyes wide, not stepping back. Drifting ash grains and cold dust hang large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取一幕第 1181 行前一夜赫塔在井边看见灯一盏盏灭、骨头折着的影子走过。弗劳洛斯用显像参考，只露一部分身子。

nodes.name: 火把
nodes.light: orange torchlight from below, pale cold light from above on the tower, a heavy dark between
nodes.camera: from the top of the tower, just behind the bell-keeper's shoulder, looking down the whitewashed tower shaft at the torches below; tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the bottom of an enormous empty pit-camp, whose terraced walls rise in rings of dark empty streets around us, every door open. At the centre a tall whitewashed bell tower rises from the pit floor, and from its top we look down. In the near foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, stands the bell-keeper at the open top of the tower, seen from behind at three-quarter: a tall grey-haired man, long-lived and unaged, in dark robes, one hand wound with a bell-rope, the other holding a short bronze bell. The great bell above him is mid-swing, frost on it. He does not look down; his head is lifted and his lips are shaping the next number. At the foot of the tower, far below and small, a group of thirty robed priests stands in a half ring holding torches, their faces turned up, the leader with one arm raised and his mouth open, shouting; the torches throw long orange shadows across the white floor and across rows of empty doorways. At the base of the tower, next to its wall, a small bowl of water and a single bone tablet sit untouched on the floor. Frost crystals and torch sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取二幕第十来天夜里血誓祭司举火把到钟楼底下喊他下来（第 1192 行）。卡尔泽因用立绘，只画背影不写脸。

nodes.name: 霜落
nodes.light: last red of a winter dusk on the horizon, the cold white of frost, no lamps on the tower
nodes.camera: low from the foot of the tower, looking straight up the whitewashed shaft past the woman; tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at the bottom of an enormous empty pit-camp, a tall whitewashed bell tower rising at the centre, its shaft covered with a thick layer of frost from foot to top. High at the top the great bell has just been struck, and the whole layer of frost is shaking loose and falling in a sheet, tumbling down the tower and the pit walls and unveiling layer upon layer of empty street rings, rows of open doors, in the dusk behind it. In the near foreground at the foot of the tower stands a thirty-one-year-old woman, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one cheek: sturdy, ash-grey skin, frost-white hair cut at the chin, a white strip of bone set along her left forearm, long arms hanging at her sides. She has just risen to her feet from a doorstep; behind her on the step a bowl of water stands untouched. Her pale amber eyes are fixed on the top of the tower, her face open, her mouth just parting to speak. On the pit rim at the top of the picture a line of small figures from the nearby camps stands silent in a long row, and one winged figure sits on the rim with his wings folded. The sky has no lights in it, only a deepening blue and the red band at the horizon. Falling frost glitter and dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取三幕上旬十日最后一声钟，十七营坑壁的霜一齐震落（第 1204 行），赫塔站了起来（第 1205 行）。远处的人和夜翼只写小人。

nodes.name: 门槛
nodes.light: low soft grey-gold light of a winter dawn, a thin warm glow from an open doorway, cold blue-grey wasteland behind
nodes.camera: low, near the threshold, looking across it at the courier and the family beyond; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early winter morning in a small stone doorway at the edge of a camp pit, a single flat-topped door with an old threshold step and a few bone tags hung over the lintel. We stand just inside the room looking out through the open door. On the threshold step in the near foreground, large, a twenty-six-year-old courier has just landed and stands in the doorway: tall, lean, narrow-shouldered, his grey-brown white-tipped wings folded down to the backs of his knees, tousled sand-gold hair, amber eyes, a bone tag worn as an earring on his left ear, a leather bag at his hip, a letter held out in both hands, his posture upright and patient, as if he is waiting. He is not looking at us but at the person at our side, out of the frame at the right edge, who is unfolding the letter with a hand that is partly visible, and only the edge of a grey-skinned sleeve is seen. Behind him, behind and below the step, a stretch of grey frozen ground runs out to the edge of the pit and over it, a few feathers on the ground at his feet. In the far background above the pit's rim a long dark line of bell towers recedes into thin mist. A few frost motes and a single grey feather drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取收束第 1215 行，罗埃尔把那一包信送完，送到一家，落地，等那一家的人读完再飞起来。收的人不入画，只露一截袖口。

nodes.line: 铁狼的年月·狗与狼的守夜
nodes.name: 半块
nodes.light: warm orange from the small fire in the gate tunnel, the cold blue of the last night before departure at the arch's mouth
nodes.camera: low, at the level of the sleeping girl's pillow, looking across her at the cook's kneeling figure; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the night before a departure, in a vaulted gate-tunnel of a great wall, a small fire burning on the stone floor at the centre, two watchtowers' dark shapes at the open south mouth of the tunnel behind. In the right foreground a small slight beast-eared girl of eighteen, who looks sixteen, lies on a pallet wrapped to the chin in a grey wool blanket, a damp cloth on her forehead, her cheeks flushed, her round white-tipped ears lying flat, her pale-gold hair damp, a short bushy tail with a small cloth-wrapped brass bell lying out from the blanket, her gold-green eyes half open and looking up. On the left, the big beast-eared cook kneels beside her in profile, a huge, round-faced man of twenty-seven, about 189 cm even kneeling, with floppy drooping ears and cream hair dusted with flour, burn scars across both hands, a soft honey-coloured gaze. He has broken a dense black loaf in two: one half goes back inside his coat, the other he is laying wrapped in a cloth next to her hand on the pallet, and her fingers have just closed round the cloth. Along the bottom of the picture, a row of thirty-eight dark rough loaves lies on a plank, each stamped with a mark. In the far dark beyond the tunnel mouth, small figures of scouts with bells wait. Drifting ash and sparks from the fire hang large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取一幕第 1393 行出发前一夜提穆把干粮掰成两半，一半放在守夜的皮雅手边。皮雅 18 岁、发烧躺着，无伤无血。

nodes.line: 铁狼的年月·狗与狼的守夜
nodes.name: 影线
who: the big cook at the rear
nodes.light: cold white-grey from the horizon glow, a faint warm ember from the machines' chests, long shadows lying on the ground
nodes.camera: from the rear of the file, behind and beside the big man's shoulder, looking forward along the line of scouts toward the south; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the second day in the dead zone, a grey plain with white grass, no wind. A long straight line, invisible on the ground, runs across the picture from left to right: on the near side of the line the scouts' shadows stand beside their feet like ordinary shadows, but on the far side every shadow has been lying down flat on the ground while the people stand. A file of thirty-eight scouts in scout-grey walks over the line in single file, far ahead and getting smaller toward the centre, each tying their steps to one rhythm, none of them stopping. At the very front, small but clear, a tall lean red-haired woman of twenty-four with black-backed pointed ears laid flat is running forward, a brass bell shining on her long thin tail; behind her at the middle of the file a thin older man with a roll of parchment in his coat walks with one hand on it. In the near right foreground, large and cut off by the frame, the last man of the file, a huge beast-eared man of twenty-seven with drooping ears and flour-dusted cream hair, is seen from behind at three-quarter: he has just crossed the line and is turning his head back over his shoulder, looking toward the north, where small and far away two watchtowers and a point of orange firelight stand at a gate in the wall. Past the line, ahead of the file, a row of eight hundred tall clockwork soldiers marches on into the white haze. A few rusted kneeling clockwork soldiers lie along the left edge, heads bowed toward the north. Pale dust and flakes of rust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取二幕第二天走到影子先倒的那道线（第 1400 行），提穆走在最后过线以前回头看门洞（第 1403 行），阿芙打头。提穆的死的那一刻直接用这一幅。

nodes.line: 铁狼的年月·狗与狼的守夜
nodes.name: 皮图
who: the young scout who copies the map
nodes.light: warm orange from the gate-tunnel fire, which stands upright and steady, a cold blue dawn at the tunnel's mouth and a south wind making the lamp flicker
nodes.camera: from the fire's side at ground level, looking across the flames at the seated man, the girl kneeling in front of him; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last hour before dawn in a vaulted gate-tunnel of a great wall, a fire burning in a pit on the stone floor and a cold south wind blowing into the open mouth of the tunnel behind. In the centre sits a thin, slightly stooped beast-eared man of forty-three, seen at three-quarter from the side, his left ear missing a corner, his scout's clothing torn into strips and hanging open: on his chest, belly and both bare forearms a map is inked in fine dark lines, coast and ridges, a line of black dots, a long dark band across it, drawn with a needle. Along the inside of his left forearm runs a column of names in tiny characters, nearly all of them struck through, and one line stretches from a struck name to the edge of the map and ends in a tiny drawn bell. His hands are stained with ink, his head is lifted and his eyes look south, his mouth closed and still. In front of him, in the near left foreground, a small slight beast-eared girl of eighteen, with white-tipped round ears and a short bushy tail with a cloth-wrapped brass bell, kneels with a parchment on a board across her knees, copying; she is shielding the page from the wind with her body and her hand holds the pen, her gold-green eyes catching the firelight. On the right, a short, wide dwarf mechanic of seventy-four with an iron-black beard braided in three strands, brass whistles at the ends, has set a lantern down at the seated man's feet and sits cross-legged by the fire. Two watchtowers stand dark at the tunnel mouth. Ash and drifting sparks hang large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取三幕第 1411 到 1414 行，劳里坐在火边解开衣裳，皮雅抄图，格里姆放灯坐了一夜。写成皮上的墨线和划掉的名字，不画伤口特写，劳里是没有立绘的人。

nodes.line: 铁狼的年月·狗与狼的守夜
nodes.name: 南望
nodes.light: warm firelight from the gate-tunnel fire on the right, a cold blue-grey dusk showing at the open arch behind them
nodes.camera: from across the fire at the level of the seated pair, looking at the two of them in profile with the arch beyond; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a quiet dusk in the gate-tunnel of a great wall, a small fire burning in a pit at the right. Two figures sit side by side on a stone bench facing right, toward the open south arch where two watchtowers frame the grey road. On the left, a thin, stooped beast-eared man of about forty-five, a missing corner on his left ear, ink-stained hands resting open on his knees, a plain grey blanket round his shoulders, his gaze fixed south along the road, his mouth closed, his face calm. Beside him, at the right of the pair and nearer the fire, a small slight beast-eared girl of nineteen with round white-tipped ears and short pale-gold hair sits turned a little toward him, not looking south but at his face, her gold-green eyes catching the firelight, a short bushy tail curled around her feet with a brass bell tied in cloth at its tip. On the stone beside her a small bundle of grey cloth lies in her lap, one hand resting on it. In the arch behind them, small and far along the grey road, a column of tall clockwork soldiers with brass keys on their backs marches south into the dusk. Fine ash and a single spark drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取收束第 1420 行，劳里又活了两年，皮雅守着他，夜里两个人坐在火边，他看南边，她看他。皮雅此时 19 到 20 岁；怀里的布包是第 1490 行的干粮。

阿芙.where: 死域里，影子先倒的线以南
阿芙.how: 她在三十八个人最前头跑，第二天过了线没有停，后面的人照着铃声走。第三天傍晚，线外头守着的人听见她的铃铛一路响到地平线，响完那一声，就再也没有响过。劳里回来的时候，图上她的名字划掉了，边上拉出一道线，一直拉到图的边上，线头上刺着一只小铃。

提穆.where: 死域里，三十八个人的队尾
提穆.how: 他烤了三十八块干粮，把自己那一块掰成两半，一半留在守夜的皮雅手边，一半揣回怀里。他走在最后，过线以前回头往门洞那边看了一眼，往后跟着阿芙的铃声往南走，没有回来。劳里回来的时候，图上他的名字划掉了。

deaths.name: 铜铃
deaths.light: a dying copper-red glow along the whole southern horizon at dusk, cold blue-grey dust-light on the ground
deaths.camera: from the dead-zone ground behind her at about knee height, looking along her path to the far horizon; strongly tilted
deaths.text: Scene: dusk on the third day, far inside the dead zone, a wide plain of grey ground and pale grass running away to a flat horizon where the sky glows a dull copper red. A tall lean red-haired scout of twenty-four is running alone, far ahead and small near the centre of the picture, seen from behind in full stride, one long leg lifted and the other driving off the ground, her black-backed pointed ears laid flat, her long thin tail streaming out behind her with a brass bell tied at its tip, polished bright and catching the last light. Across her forehead, above the viewer's right eyebrow, a faint old scar shows when she turns her head a little and we catch her face in profile, orange-gold eyes narrowed to slits and her mouth in a laugh, looking at the far horizon and not blinking. Her shadow lies flat on the ground beside her, long and thin, while she herself runs upright. Far behind her, small and dim, the line of other scouts has stopped and crouched on the ground as the bell stops guiding them. Along the foreground a few rusted kneeling clockwork soldiers lie with heads bowed north, and white grass bends toward the south. Pale dust and a few flakes of rust hang large and out of focus across the near corners.
deaths.note: 阿芙最后被人看见的那一拍是第三天傍晚铃响到地平线（第 1406 行）。源稿没写她怎么死的，这一幅只画她跑在最前头、笑着看南边的那一下，不画别的。

notes: 阿芙的死源稿没有写怎么死，只写铃响到地平线就再也没有响过，死的那一刻只画她在跑；要不要让她的名字边上那一只刺着的小铃入画，主会话定。
提穆的死的那一刻直接用 s18_d2（他过线以前回头看门洞），请主会话看这一幅能不能同时当他的。
劳里没有立绘键，也不在任务单的旅伴和相遇里，check_scenes 不收他的 fates，我删了；他10772年炎潮月死在门洞边的斥候屋，要不要给他单开一条，请主会话定。另外深耕座上一百零六人、长链号前舱两个水手、三座营的白骸、斥候队另外三十五人也都不是旅伴或相遇，没写 fates；d3、d4 里劳里的长相照源稿第 1443 行写，四十三岁，瘦，背有一点驼，左耳缺一角。
d3 劳里皮上的墨线地图和划掉的名字写成纹身一样的细线，不画血和伤口的特写，请主会话看出图时是否稳。
d4 皮雅是 10770 到 10772 年之间的 19 到 20 岁，已成年，没有伤。
a2 的擎天级只画背面，那一位正神和那一尊魔神按锁不入画；beast 用 strife_other_047_1 的外形。
c1 的 beast 用 god_m_jingguang_06，但源稿写弗劳洛斯只在远处影子里，出图时只露一部分、不露脸。
c2 卡尔泽因的 battle 套资料我没有逐套看，只用它的长相，请主会话确认 z6b_karzein 的 battle 是不是合适的衣着（他在源稿里是钟楼长）。
b4 没有立绘人物，只用墙上的兵；是否改成芬珂站在舰首更稳，请主会话定。
四条主线里卡尔泽因、霍布、岑瓦这些传奇没入画，岑瓦第二十来天夜里来过一夜的那一拍我没取。
